text:
maria_support: Customer reported that their tool calls keep routing to the generic fallback tool even though the request explicitly names a specialized variant. repro attached.

cj_engineer: can you paste the raw request body they sent and which SDK/version?

maria_support: they said it happens from both Python and Go SDKs. versions: py-sdk@0.12.3, go-sdk@0.6.0. here is the captured request (redacted keys):

maria_support: ```json
{"model":"redwood-serve","input":"...","tool_call": {"name":"analyzer","variant":"CompactV1","args": {"text":"lots of logs"}}}
```

nina_py: interesting — our server expects tool.variant values in snake_case (e.g., "compact_v1"). if the variant isn't recognized the selector logs a warning and uses the first compatible fallback tool. do we have the server log for that session?

maria_support: yep, customer provided this snippet from the runtime logs: 

maria_support: ```
2025-08-03T14:12:07.423Z tool_selector WARN unknown variant 'CompactV1' for tool 'analyzer', falling back to 'generic_processor'
2025-08-03T14:12:07.424Z request TRACE matched tools: [generic_processor]
```

alex_go: ok that suggests the Go client serialized the enum differently. can we see what the Go SDK sent (raw bytes) and what the Python SDK sent for the same payload?

maria_support: they provided both. Go: 

maria_support: ```
{"tool_call":{"name":"analyzer","variant":"CompactV1","args":{...}}}
```

maria_support: Python: 

maria_support: ```
{"tool_call":{"name":"analyzer","variant":"COMPACT_V1","args":{...}}}
```

cj_engineer: wow, three different serializations: CompactV1, COMPACT_V1, and server expects compact_v1. this smells like inconsistent enum/stringer behavior across SDKs + no normalization on server side.

nina_py: quick repro I made locally (py-sdk):

nina_py: ```py
from redwood import ToolCall, Variant
req = ToolCall(name="analyzer", variant=Variant.COMPACT_V1)
print(req.json())  # prints variant: "COMPACT_V1"
```

alex_go: minimal go example shows similar (go-sdk):

alex_go: ```go
type ToolCall struct {
  Name string `json:"name"`
  Variant Variant `json:"variant"`
}
var t = ToolCall{Name: "analyzer", Variant: CompactV1}
// encoding/json uses Variant.String() -> "CompactV1"
```

cj_engineer: TL;DR: three representations from clients + server is strict. consequences: tool selector falls back, causing user-facing functional regression.

maria_support: customer impact: production jobs that depend on analyzer:v1 stopped using the optimized pipeline and billing increased ~3x because generic_processor is CPU-bound and slower. they opened a billing dispute.

cj_engineer: immediate mitigation options: 1) support can ask customer to patch their client to send a raw string "compact_v1" (ugly), 2) server team can add a normalization pass mapping common variants case-insensitively and converting Camel/SCREAM to snake_case, 3) ship SDK patch to stringify enums as snake_case.

nina_py: I can draft a quick py-sdk patch to serialize Variant enums to snake_case by default (0.12.4). also add a compatibility flag to allow sending raw strings.

alex_go: I'll add a helper to the go-sdk that implements MarshalJSON for Variant to produce snake_case. will open PR targeting 0.6.1.

cj_engineer: server-side fix is higher confidence for short term. I'll open an incident PR to add normalization in tool_selector: convert incoming variant to lower + replace /(?<=.)(?=[A-Z])/ with '_' or simply run a normalization util that handles CamelCase, SCREAMING_SNAKE, and kebab-case -> snake_case. add a fast path mapping table for known variants to avoid surprises.

maria_support: customer asked for ETA and whether we can temporarily whitelist "CompactV1" and "COMPACT_V1" for analyzer.

cj_engineer: ops-bot, please create an ops ticket to whitelist those variant strings for the analyzer tool for customer org org-1234 and apply for 72 hours.

ops-bot: Created OPS-4521: whitelist analyzer variants [CompactV1, COMPACT_V1] for org-1234 for 72h. Assignee: @cj_engineer.

nina_py: PRs I'll open: py-sdk/normalize-enum-serialization (0.12.4) and add test cases that assert JSON contains "compact_v1".

alex_go: go-sdk/variant-marshal-fix (0.6.1) with similar tests.

cj_engineer: server PR: tool-selector/variant-normalize (patch + unit tests). must be behind a feature flag to toggle quickly. I'll estimate 1d to land, 2d to roll to prod safely. ops: enable whitelist now, enable server-side normalize behind flag after tests.

maria_support: customer ok with whitelist ASAP and then patching clients. asked for a short postmortem once resolved.

cj_engineer: notes for postmortem: root cause = inconsistent enum serialization across SDKs + lack of normalization in selector. Prevention: a) normalize variants at ingress, b) add e2e tests across py/ts/go SDKs round-trip, c) publish SDK enum serialization contract in API docs.

maria_support: assigning followups: OPS-4521 (whitelist), SDK PRs nina_py/alex_go, SERVER-7789 (normalize). i'll update the customer thread and close once server fix + SDKs released. :thumbsup:

nina_py: :eyes: I'll add the compatibility flag so teams can opt into stricter validation later.

alex_go: thanks all, will ping when go PR merged.

cj_engineer: leaving thread open until server fix rolled and PRs merged.
